note: Music bed for the Spider-Man 1 reel pack (2026-11-16): one section per reel on its first beat. R01 (the Venom tease) and R04 (Fisk's threat) on the tension bed, R02 (Otto's grudge) on the main theme, R03 (Jeff and Miles) and R05 (Li and Peter) on the home theme Red.
